items.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995
items.q: we used to play behind a singer on this radio station, Jackie Hill.

ctx.x: What was your next, what you consider to be your next important engagement perhaps, after that?

Well I worked around St. Louis, in the Chase Hotel, in the Park Plaza. I was on staff, one of the musicians of the radio station. I’ll never forget the guy that had the band on this radio station, his name was Carl Hoengarden. And he started Gordon Jenkins out. Gordon was from a suburb of St. Louis, and he started Gordon Jenkins out. And he used to write, we used to play behind a singer on this radio station, Jackie Hill. And Carl would do the arrangements and conduct the group, the band, and he wrote in some…
Was that because it was for a singer?
